days.title: High Peaks of Gennargentu
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Punta La Marmora
stops.detail: The island's highest mountain peaks are found here, reaching the maximum altitude with the 1,834 meters of Punta La Marmora.

stops.name: Bruncu Spina
stops.detail: Some of the highest peaks of the mountain complex are Bruncu Spina (1,828 meters), Punta Florisa (1,822 meters), Punta Paolina (1,792 meters), Punta Erba Irdes (1,703 meters), Bruncu Allasu (1,701 meters), Monte Iscudu (1,676 meters) and Monte Spada (1,595 meters).

days.title: Supramonte Highlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Supramonte
stops.detail: The Supramonte region develops in a series of karst plateaus formed by limestone rocks dating back to the Mesozoic.

stops.name: Monte Corrasi
stops.detail: The plateau is surrounded by a series of mountain peaks whose maximum altitude is reached by Monte Corrasi, with its 1,463 meters.

days.title: Ancient Forests and Plateaus
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Punta Solitta
stops.detail: Punta Solitta, with its 1,206 meters, is one of these.

stops.name: Sas Baddes
stops.detail: The plateaus and heights of Supramonte are instead dominated by holm oak forests, as in the case of the "Sas Baddes" holm oak grove, included within the perimeter of the Montes state forest, one of the last primary forests still present in Europe.
